note: Lean fixes φ = t²e^{−t²/2}, works at y = x/κ, keeps the w < w₀ term, corrects the δ ↦ wδ scaling, and uses gx with 0.8764/2.526/3.8. Erratum: The first case (11.18)–(11.19) omits the term C_{φ,0,K} = 1.04488∫₀^{1/K}φ that its proof produces and the second case keeps; for a continuous φ concentrated near w = 2.75/x (x = 10³⁰, K = 8, q = 8·10⁸, δ = 0), |S_{η*}(α,x)| ≥ 0.18|φ|₁x while g_{x,φ}(q)|φ|₁x ≤ 0.01|φ|₁x.
